terms.title: Terms and waiver
terms.body: Partants connects people who want to do an activity together. Each session is organized under the sole responsibility of its organizer. By joining a session, you acknowledge you take part at your own risk, according to your level and fitness. You commit to showing up when signed up, or dropping out ahead of time. Respect, fair play and safety are non-negotiable: any inappropriate behaviour can be reported and lead to account removal.
terms.privacy: Your data is only used to run the app (Québec Law 25). You can delete your account at any time from your profile.
